classification_basis: one primary request manifest per research role; Q00 independent manifests; M00 own probes; de-duplicated only where URL/payload/time/category identical
coverage_note: retained request observations, not exact billable HTTP request counts; absent status/time remains unknown

request_json.query: query { vaults(first: 5, where: {chainId_in: [8453]}) { items { address name asset { address symbol } } } }

not_observed_meaning: No retained observation, not proof these services never need auth or never limit traffic.

category_definitions.ENV_PROXY_CONNECT_403: Proxy CONNECT rejected before upstream API. Enforced allowlist excludes target, consistent with environmental egress block; upstream auth/rate behavior not observed.
category_definitions.HTTP_404_SOURCE_PATH: HTTP 404 at requested source URL. Path/branch/repo moved, deletion, or hidden/private resource are possible; exact cause unproven unless a scoped canonical replacement is independently verified. Not proof of stopped chain/market.
category_definitions.HTTP_SUCCESS: Retained HTTP success, not necessarily deployed/current market validation.
